text: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to this year's Business Leadership Conference. I'm Rachel Torres, and I'll be coordinating today's events. I need to let you know about a schedule change. Unfortunately, the speaker for our eleven o'clock session has had his flight delayed and won't arrive until this afternoon. So we've decided to move that session to two PM. In its place, we'll have an extended coffee break and networking opportunity in the main lobby. Everything else on the schedule remains the same, so the keynote will start right on time at nine, followed by Marketing Trends at ten. Please check the updated schedule at the registration desk. Thank you for your flexibility.

text: Attention customers. Hartwell Appliances wishes to inform you of a voluntary product recall affecting certain models of our HW-3000 series electric kettle. The affected units were manufactured between January and April of this year and may have a defect in the power cord that could pose a potential safety risk. If you purchased an HW-3000 kettle during this period, please stop using it immediately and check the model number printed on the base of the unit. If your kettle falls within the affected range — model numbers HW-3001 through HW-3045 — please return it to any Hartwell authorized retailer for a full refund or replacement. No receipt is required. For more information, please visit our website or call our customer care line at 1-800-555-0088. We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience.
